newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Heung Chang develops new telecom device.
newsitem.headline: Heung Chang develops new telecom device.

text.p: South Korea's Heung Chang Products Co said on Thursday it had developed key equipment for digital mobile telephone systems using its own technology.
Heung Chang's spokesman Choi Myoung-jin said the development of a linear power amplifier would help lift its annual sales by about 50 billion won in calendar 1997.
The company's annual sales for this year are projected at about 100 billion won, he said.
Choi also said the company was due to announce an export contract worth about $200 million early next week involving cable television receiver systems.
According to market talk, Heung Chang has agreed to export $200 million worth of satellite-relayed cable television receiver sets to a Kuwaiti company.
Choi declined to identify the partner company. "Please wait until we make the announcement next week," Choi said.
